name: ghostrepo
description: Bring abandoned GitHub projects back to life.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:dashboard
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @ghostrepo/github -w @ghostrepo/scoring -w @ghostrepo/dependencies && npm run build -w @ghostrepo/core -w @ghostrepo/reports && npm run build -w ghostrepo
scripts.dev:dashboard: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w ghostrepo-dashboard
